Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

teacher — a person who helps students learn. Example: My sister is a teacher.
doctor — a person who treats ill people. Example: The doctor says I should rest.
engineer — a person who designs machines or buildings. Example: My father is an engineer.
manager — a person who leads a team at work. Example: My cousin is a manager in a bank.
driver — a person who drives a vehicle. Example: My uncle is a driver.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What do you do?
• I am a ...
• He is an ...
• She works in a ...
• It is a good job.

Grammar focus: Present Simple for work routines.
Ask about jobs: What do you do? I am a teacher. Use a or an before the job: a doctor, an engineer. Add -s with he and she: She works in a hospital.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.

Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What do you do? B: I am a teacher. A: And your brother? B: He is a driver.
